text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove an accessible loading zone located on the north side of Sammon Avenue, between a point 9 metres east of Wiley Avenue and a point 9.5 metres further east, as the accessible loading zone is no longer required.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone located on the north side of Sammon Avenue, between a point 9 metres east of Wiley Avenue and a point 9.5 metres further east.
